response: Yes, surrogates of injury severity can influence the occurrence of heterotopic ossification (HO) in fractures of the acetabulum. According to the retrieved matches, surrogates of injury severity, including days in the ICU and non-ICU hospital LOS > 10 days, were associated with the development of HO in patients with acetabular fractures. This suggests that the severity of the injury can play a role in the development of HO. Additionally, prophylaxis with radiation therapy (XRT) was found to be significantly protective against the development of HO, and the ability to provide prophylaxis is likely related to the severity of the injury.
